== Description ==

Tournament tables at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025, featuring [[Karl Koenig]] (front left, red quarter-zip sweater), [[Logan Pietig]] (foreground, black shirt), [[Taylor Gosiaco]] (right, navy shirt and glasses), and [[Robbie Hendon]] (standing back right); other players unlabeled.
